title: Graduation Thesis (Logistics and Supply Chain Management)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply advanced logistics knowledge to solve practical problems.
Utilize foundational knowledge in international business, international trade, logistics, and supply chain management.
Draft, review, and present professional reports on logistics and supply chain management topics.
Conduct independent research and present findings effectively.
Analyze and identify opportunities, developing feasible solutions for logistics and supply chain issues.
Demonstrate self-reliance and personal responsibility in work.
Express and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches.
Provide objective and scientific evaluations of professional issues.

minimum_entry_skills.skill_name: Basic Knowledge of Logistics and Supply Chain Management
